slots.notes: Rotating pool of 5 full-bleed card background images (3 shown at a time). Each fills an h-[500px] rounded card via bg-cover bg-center and zooms to scale-105 on hover. A bottom-up black gradient overlay sits on top for text legibility, so images need no built-in transparency or safe-area; subjects should read with a dark lower third.
Previous/left chevron glyph inside a w-10 h-10 round outline button; rendered w-5 h-5, stroke tinted by fg (black). Defaults to Lucide ChevronLeft.
Next/right chevron glyph inside a w-10 h-10 round outline button; rendered w-5 h-5, stroke tinted by fg (black). Defaults to Lucide ChevronRight.

mechanic: A 3-up card grid windowing a 5-card pool that auto-advances every 4s (and via prev/next chevrons), where each slot swaps with a direction-aware AnimatePresence popLayout slide (opacity + x + scale), all staggered into view on a once-only scroll reveal.
techDelivery: standalone Vite + React 18 + TypeScript, Tailwind CSS utility classes, Framer Motion (AnimatePresence/motion/useInView), and Lucide React icons
reskinNotes: Card text legibility depends on the hardcoded bottom-up black gradient overlay (from-black/80 via-black/20 to-transparent) plus white label/description text, so light or low-contrast brand images and any non-white fg color will break readability. The on-image label and description copy use a fixed white (fgMuted is white, not a true muted tone) and are not theme-driven. Card count is pinned to 5 in the data array with exactly 3 visible via modulo windowing; supplying a different number of images requires editing the array and the slice logic. The pool labels/headlines and the 'FlowMate' wordmark are hardcoded in markup, and nav arrows are Lucide components (swapping icon sets means changing imports, not just an asset).
